name: uk.ac.horizon.artcodes.scanner.ScannerActivity
description: The Artcodes Scanner SDK (Horizon Institute / University of Nottingham) opens the camera to scan Artcode markers for an experience. When it recognizes a marker, it opens the experience’s configured link with the code or returns the code to the calling app.
disableEffect: The app will not be able to scan Artcodes markers or open the linked experience from this screen.
